add.type: <FIELDS extends string>(left: AggregationExpression<FIELDS>, right: AggregationExpression<FIELDS>) => BinaryAggregationExpression<FIELDS>

any.doc:
Any one value of a field within each group, of any type.
`{ type: 'any', field, alias, filter? }`.
tags: @throws TypeError when `field` or `alias` is invalid.
any.type: <FIELDS extends string>(field: FIELDS, alias: string, { filter: predicate }?: AggregationMetricOptions<FIELDS> | undefined) => AnyAggregationMetric<FIELDS>

avg.doc: The average of an expression; see {@link aggregation.sum}.
avg.type: <FIELDS extends string>(expression: AggregationExpression<FIELDS>, alias: string, options?: AggregationMetricOptions<FIELDS> | undefined) => NumericAggregationMetric<FIELDS>

constant.doc: A number, as an operand. `{ type: 'constant', value }`.
tags: @throws TypeError when `value` is not finite.

count.doc: The number of rows in each group. `{ type: 'count', alias, filter? }`.
tags: @param alias - The name of the metric column in the result rows.
@param options.filter - Counts only the rows that match.
@throws TypeError when `alias` is invalid.
count.type: <FIELDS extends string = string>(alias: string, { filter: predicate }?: AggregationMetricOptions<FIELDS> | undefined) => CountAggregationMetric<FIELDS>

dateDiff.doc:
The time from the instant in `from` to the instant in `to`, `to − from`,
in `unit`, as a signed decimal: negative when `to` is earlier, and no
value when either instant is absent. A `DAY` is exactly 24 hours.
`{ type: 'date-diff', from, to, unit }`. Both fields must be
single-valued time fields, those whose `aggregate.groups` list
`DATE_HISTOGRAM` in the descriptor, and `unit` one of its
`analysis.dateDiffUnits`. Wow 9.2 and later.
tags:
@throws TypeError when `from` or `to` is not a valid field path, or
`unit` is not a {@link DateDiffUnit}.
dateDiff.type: <FIELDS extends string>(from: FIELDS, to: FIELDS, unit: DateDiffUnit) => DateDiffAggregationExpression<FIELDS>

dateHistogram.doc:
Groups a time field into calendar buckets.
`{ type: 'date-histogram', field, unit, alias, timeZone, dense? }`.
tags: @param field - The time field (epoch milliseconds) to bucket.
@param alias - The name of the bucket column in the result rows.
@param options.unit - The calendar unit of a bucket.
@param options.timeZone - The zone buckets are cut in. Defaults to `UTC`.

@param options.dense - Whether the empty buckets of the range are filled
in.
dateHistogram.type: <FIELDS extends string>(field: FIELDS, alias: string, { unit, timeZone, dense, scope }: DateHistogramAggregationOptions) => DateHistogramAggregationGroup<FIELDS>

datePart.doc:
Groups a time field by one calendar part of each instant, such as the
weekday or the hour, so records from different days share a bucket.
`{ type: 'date-part', field, part, alias, timeZone, dense? }`.

The group's keys in the result rows are integers: `DAY_OF_WEEK` is the
ISO weekday, 1 (Monday) to 7 (Sunday); `DAY_OF_MONTH` 1 to 31;
`HOUR_OF_DAY` 0 to 23 on the wall clock of `timeZone`; `MONTH_OF_YEAR`
1 to 12. With `dense`, every key of that domain comes back, those
without records carrying each metric's empty value; `dense` needs the
group to be the query's only one. Wow 9.2 and later.
tags: @param field - The time field (epoch milliseconds) to read the part of.
@param alias - The name of the part column in the result rows.
@param options.part - The calendar part to group by.

@param options.timeZone - The zone the part is read in. Defaults to
`UTC`.

@param options.dense - Whether every key of the part's domain is
returned.
datePart.type: <FIELDS extends string>(field: FIELDS, alias: string, { part, timeZone, dense, scope }: DatePartAggregationOptions) => DatePartAggregationGroup<FIELDS>

derived.doc:
A metric computed from other metrics of the same row, by their aliases.
`{ type: 'derived', expression, alias }`. `aggregation.query()` checks
that it refers only to metrics declared before it.
tags: @throws TypeError when `alias` is invalid, or a `constant` is not finite.
derived.type: (expression: DerivedExpression | ((d: DerivedExpressionDsl) => DerivedExpression), alias: string) => DerivedAggregationMetric

distinctCount.doc:
The number of distinct values of an expression.
`{ type: 'distinct-count', expression, alias, filter? }`.
distinctCount.type: <FIELDS extends string>(expression: AggregationExpression<FIELDS>, alias: string, { filter: predicate }?: AggregationMetricOptions<FIELDS> | undefined) => DistinctCountAggregationMetric<FIELDS>

divide.type: <FIELDS extends string>(left: AggregationExpression<FIELDS>, right: AggregationExpression<FIELDS>) => BinaryAggregationExpression<FIELDS>

element.doc:
Aggregates over the elements of an array field instead of the root
documents. `{ path, filter? }`.
tags: @param path - The array field, a query field path.

@throws TypeError when `path` is not a valid field path or `predicate`
contains a root filter.
element.type: (path: string, predicate?: ElementFilterExpression | ExpressionFilter | undefined) => AggregationElement

field.doc: The value of a field, as an operand. `{ type: 'field', field }`.
tags: @throws TypeError when `field` is not a valid field path.

first.doc:
The value of `field` on each group's earliest record by `orderBy`.
`{ type: 'first', field, alias, orderBy?, filter? }`.

The value comes back in the field's own type, or `null` when no record
of the group has both a value and an `orderBy` position. Without
`orderBy` the server orders by the model's event time, which the
descriptor names as `analysis.firstLastOrderBy`. Neither a derived
metric nor `having` may refer to it. Wow 9.2 and later.
tags: @throws TypeError when `field`, `orderBy` or `alias` is invalid.
first.type: <FIELDS extends string>(field: FIELDS, alias: string, options?: EdgeAggregationOptions<FIELDS> | undefined) => EdgeAggregationMetric<FIELDS>

having.doc:
The builders of the query's `having`: conditions on the metric columns of
the grouped rows (`eq`, `ne`, `gt`, `gte`, `lt`, `lte`, `between`, `isIn`,
`isNull`, `isNotNull`) and their `and`/`or`. See `HavingDsl`.

histogram.doc:
Groups a number field, or a computed expression, into buckets of equal
width. `{ type: 'histogram', field | expression, interval, alias }`.
tags:
@param input - The number field to bucket, or an expression in its
place (Wow 9.2 and later, an expensive computation).
@param alias - The name of the bucket column in the result rows.
@param options.interval - The bucket width.

@throws TypeError when `interval` is not finite and greater than 0, or
`field` or `alias` is invalid.
histogram.type: <FIELDS extends string>(input: FIELDS | AggregationExpression<FIELDS>, alias: string, { interval, scope }: HistogramAggregationOptions) => HistogramAggregationGroup<FIELDS>

last.doc:
The value of `field` on each group's latest record by `orderBy`.
`{ type: 'last', field, alias, orderBy?, filter? }`. As
{@link aggregation.first}, from the other end.
tags: @throws TypeError when `field`, `orderBy` or `alias` is invalid.
last.type: <FIELDS extends string>(field: FIELDS, alias: string, options?: EdgeAggregationOptions<FIELDS> | undefined) => EdgeAggregationMetric<FIELDS>

max.doc: The greatest value of an expression; see {@link aggregation.sum}.
max.type: <FIELDS extends string>(expression: AggregationExpression<FIELDS>, alias: string, options?: AggregationMetricOptions<FIELDS> | undefined) => NumericAggregationMetric<FIELDS>

min.doc: The least value of an expression; see {@link aggregation.sum}.
min.type: <FIELDS extends string>(expression: AggregationExpression<FIELDS>, alias: string, options?: AggregationMetricOptions<FIELDS> | undefined) => NumericAggregationMetric<FIELDS>

multiply.type: <FIELDS extends string>(left: AggregationExpression<FIELDS>, right: AggregationExpression<FIELDS>) => BinaryAggregationExpression<FIELDS>

percentile.doc:
A percentile of an expression.
`{ type: 'percentile', expression, percentile, alias, filter? }`.
tags: @param options.percentile - Which percentile, within (0, 100).

@throws TypeError when `percentile` is not finite and within (0, 100), or
`alias` is invalid.
percentile.type: <FIELDS extends string>(expression: AggregationExpression<FIELDS>, alias: string, { percentile, filter: predicate }: PercentileAggregationOptions<FIELDS>) => PercentileAggregationMetric<FIELDS>

query.doc:
Admits a whole aggregation query against the rules Wow enforces on arrival.

The factories above each check their own part; only the assembled query
can answer the questions that span parts — whether two aliases collide,
whether a sort names one of them, whether `having` has rows to filter.
Wow checks all of it in `AggregationQuery`'s constructor and answers a
query that fails with a 400, so the same rules run here against the object
about to be sent.
query.type: <ROOT_FIELDS extends string = string, AGGREGATION_FIELDS extends string = ROOT_FIELDS>(query: AggregationQuery<ROOT_FIELDS, AGGREGATION_FIELDS>) => AggregationQuery<ROOT_FIELDS, AGGREGATION_FIELDS>

stddev.doc: The standard deviation of an expression; see {@link aggregation.sum}.
stddev.type: <FIELDS extends string>(expression: AggregationExpression<FIELDS>, alias: string, options?: AggregationMetricOptions<FIELDS> | undefined) => NumericAggregationMetric<FIELDS>

subtract.type: <FIELDS extends string>(left: AggregationExpression<FIELDS>, right: AggregationExpression<FIELDS>) => BinaryAggregationExpression<FIELDS>

sum.doc:
The sum of an expression. `{ type: 'numeric', function: 'sum',
expression, alias, filter? }`.
sum.type: <FIELDS extends string>(expression: AggregationExpression<FIELDS>, alias: string, options?: AggregationMetricOptions<FIELDS> | undefined) => NumericAggregationMetric<FIELDS>

terms.doc:
Groups by each distinct value of a field, or of a computed expression.
`{ type: 'terms', field, alias, missingKey? }`, or
`{ type: 'terms', expression, alias }`.
tags:
@param input - The field to group by, or an expression in its place
(Wow 9.2 and later, an expensive computation).
@param alias - The name of the group column in the result rows.

@param options.missingKey - The key of the rows without a value; only
with a field.

@throws TypeError when `input` or `alias` is invalid, `missingKey` is
blank, or `missingKey` is given with an expression.
terms.type: <FIELDS extends string>(input: FIELDS | AggregationExpression<FIELDS>, alias: string, { missingKey, scope }?: TermsAggregationOptions | undefined) => TermsAggregationGroup<FIELDS>

variance.doc: The variance of an expression; see {@link aggregation.sum}.
variance.type: <FIELDS extends string>(expression: AggregationExpression<FIELDS>, alias: string, options?: AggregationMetricOptions<FIELDS> | undefined) => NumericAggregationMetric<FIELDS>
